title: bento-builder vars
description: Variables for Bento builder virtualization environment

BENTO_DIR.description: Path to the local bento repository (default: auto-detected)

BENTO_REPO_URL.description: Git repository URL for the Bento fork (default: https://github.com/SamuelMarks/bento.git)

BENTO_BRANCH.description: Git branch to checkout in the Bento repository (default: multi-os-qemu-aarch64)

BENTO_BUILDER_REPO_URL.description: Component-prefixed Git repository URL for the Bento fork (default: https://github.com/SamuelMarks/bento.git)

BENTO_BUILDER_BRANCH.description: Component-prefixed Git branch to checkout in the Bento repository (default: multi-os-qemu-aarch64)

INSTALL_VIRTUALBOX.description: Install VirtualBox 7.0 and Extension Pack (1 or 0)

INSTALL_VAGRANT.description: Install HashiCorp Vagrant and plugins (1 or 0)

INSTALL_IMAGE_TOOLS.description: Install ISO/WIM tools like wimtools, xorriso, 7zip (1 or 0)
